data_description.plant_count: A plant is everything behind one inverter. Can be changed at any time.
data_description.power_sign: How the meter counts. Chosen wrongly the card shows the flow reversed.

user.description: One site can hold several plants. Modules, charge controllers, batteries and inverters are filled in afterwards under “Configure”.
user.title: Set up PV system

data_description.capacity_kwh: Nominal capacity from the label. Together with the state of charge it gives the stored energy in kWh.
data_description.current_entity: Battery current. Its sign's meaning is set below.
data_description.enabled: Off when this plant has no storage. The block is then omitted.
data_description.health_entity: State of health in percent, if the BMS reports it.
data_description.min_soc: Discharge stops here. Remaining runtime is calculated against this limit.
data_description.power_entity: Charge and discharge power. If absent, voltage × current is used.
data_description.power_sign: How the meter counts. Chosen wrongly the card shows the flow reversed.
data_description.soc_entity: State of charge in percent, usually from the BMS. Without it stored energy and runtime stay empty.
data_description.voltage_entity: Terminal voltage of the battery (e.g. 51.8 V on a 48 V system).

battery.description:
Capacity and state of charge together give the stored energy.

Almost everything may be left empty. What you leave out simply is not shown on the card - only the fields marked with * are required.
battery.title: Battery – {plant}

data_description.enabled: Off when the modules go straight to the inverter. The whole block is then omitted.
data_description.input_voltage_entity: The voltage coming from the modules - often three digits on an MPPT.
data_description.max_current: Display only, e.g. 85 A on an MPPT 250/85.
data_description.output_voltage_entity: The voltage on the battery side, i.e. 24 V, 48 V and so on.
data_description.power_entity: Charging power towards the battery. If absent it is computed from output voltage × output current.
data_description.temperature_entity: Temperature of the controller itself, not of the battery.
data_description.yield_entity: kWh meter that many MPPT controllers provide.

charger.description:
Without a charge controller the modules go straight to the inverter - leave the switch above off.

Almost everything may be left empty. What you leave out simply is not shown on the card - only the fields marked with * are required.
charger.title: Charge controller – {plant}

data_description.export_power_entity: Counterpart to import power - likewise only needed with separate meters.
data_description.import_power_entity: Only needed if your meter reports import and export separately instead of one signed figure.
data_description.l1_power_entity: Power on L1. Leave empty if you only have the total meter - the card then does not draw phases individually.
data_description.phases: Phases of the house connection. Almost always three - only change it if you know otherwise.
data_description.power_entity: The total across all phases at the house connection. The most important field here.
data_description.power_sign: How the meter counts. Chosen wrongly the card shows the flow reversed.

grid.description:
The total meter is enough. If phases are measured individually the card draws them separately.

Almost everything may be left empty. What you leave out simply is not shown on the card - only the fields marked with * are required.
grid.title: Grid and meter

data_description.calculate: Consumption = inverter power + grid power. A measured value takes precedence.
data_description.energy_entity: kWh meter of house consumption, if available.
data_description.power_entity: A measured house consumption, if you have one. It takes precedence over the calculation. Empty is the normal case.

init.description: Changes are only applied once you pick “Save and close” in the menu.
init.title: PV system

data_description.ac_voltage_entity: Grid voltage at the output, typically around 230 V.
data_description.dc_voltage_entity: DC voltage at the input - the battery voltage on a battery inverter.
data_description.enabled: Off when this plant has no inverter of its own.
data_description.hybrid: On when the device can also charge from the grid (e.g. Victron MultiPlus).
data_description.phase: Which phase this single-phase inverter feeds into.
data_description.power_entity: AC output power - the built-in sensor or an inline meter such as a Shelly. House consumption is derived from this figure.
data_description.rated_power_w: Continuous rating from the label. The load bar is based on it.

inverter.description:
Designed for single-phase inverters running in parallel with the grid.

Almost everything may be left empty. What you leave out simply is not shown on the card - only the fields marked with * are required.
inverter.title: Inverter – {plant}

data_description.count: How many modules belong to this plant.
data_description.current_entity: String current (DC) on the module side. May be left empty.
data_description.energy_entity: A kWh meter for this array's yield, if you have one. May be left empty.
data_description.parallel: Four in series, two such strings in parallel makes eight modules.
data_description.peak_wp: Peak power of a single module as printed on its label.
data_description.power_entity: What the modules currently deliver - the DC sensor of the charge controller or inverter. Empty: the charge controller fills in, otherwise the card leaves it blank.
data_description.series: Leave empty to get a matching layout suggested.
data_description.voltage_entity: Voltage of the module string (DC), e.g. 148 V for four modules in series - not the battery voltage. May be left empty.

modules.description:
Current layout: {peak}

Almost everything may be left empty. What you leave out simply is not shown on the card - only the fields marked with * are required.
modules.title: Modules – {plant}

plant_menu.description:
**{plant}**

Changes are only applied once you pick “Save and close” in the menu.
plant_menu.title: Plant

plants.description: {count} plants are set up. Which one do you want to edit?
plants.title: Plants

remove_plant.description: Remove a plant including all its sensors.

plant.description: Id or name of the plant.
plant.name: Plant

remove_plant.name: Remove plant

set_battery.description: Change capacity and nominal voltage of a battery.
set_battery.name: Set battery

set_charger.description: Change system voltage and charge current of a controller.
set_charger.name: Set charge controller

set_inverter.description: Change rated power and phase of an inverter.

phase.description: Which phase this single-phase inverter feeds into.
phase.name: Phase

set_inverter.name: Set inverter

set_modules.description: Change count, power and layout of a plant's modules.

count.description: How many modules belong to this plant.
count.name: Number of modules

parallel.description: Four in series, two such strings in parallel makes eight modules.
parallel.name: Parallel strings

peak_wp.description: Peak power of a single module as printed on its label.
peak_wp.name: Power per module

series.description: Leave empty to get a matching layout suggested.
series.name: Modules in series per string

set_modules.name: Set modules
